description: Indulge in the rich, creamy perfection of our homemade New York Baked Cheesecake – a true American classic dessert. This iconic dessert features a dense, smooth cream cheese filling atop a buttery graham cracker crust, baked to a golden finish. It's the ultimate treat for any occasion, offering a delightful balance of tang and sweetness.

instructions.title: Prepare the Crust
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 350F (175C). Lightly grease a 9-inch springform pan. In a medium bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, and melted butter. Press the mixture firmly and evenly into the bottom of the prepared springform pan. Bake for 8 minutes, then remove from oven and let cool slightly.

instructions.title: Make the Cheesecake Filling
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, using an electric mixer on medium speed, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth and creamy, about 2-3 minutes. Gradually add 1 cup granulated sugar and the all-purpose flour, beating until just combined. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.

instructions.title: Incorporate Remaining Wet Ingredients
instructions.text: Reduce mixer speed to low. Add the sour cream, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest (if using), mixing until just combined. Do not overmix. Gently beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing only until each egg is incorporated. Overmixing after adding eggs can introduce too much air, which can cause cracks.

instructions.title: Assemble and Initial Bake
instructions.text: Pour the cheesecake filling over the cooled graham cracker crust in the springform pan. Gently tap the pan on the counter a few times to release any air bubbles. Place the springform pan on a baking sheet. Bake at 350F (175C) for 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Continue Baking and Cool Down
instructions.text: After 15 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 300F (150C) and continue baking for another 20 minutes, or until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly when gently shaken. Turn off the oven, prop the oven door open slightly, and let the cheesecake cool inside the oven for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Chill Thoroughly
instructions.text: Remove the cheesecake from the oven and place it on a wire rack to cool completely to room temperature. Once cool, cover the cheesecake loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, before serving. This crucial step allows the cheesecake to firm up and fully develop its classic dense, creamy texture.

tips: Room Temperature Ingredients are Key: Ensure your cream cheese, eggs, and sour cream are at room temperature. This helps them blend smoothly, preventing lumps and ensuring a perfectly uniform, creamy texture.

Do Not Overmix the Filling: Overmixing, especially after adding eggs, can incorporate too much air into the batter. This air will expand during baking and then collapse, often leading to cracks in your cheesecake.

Chill Time is Crucial: After baking, allow the cheesecake to cool gradually, then chill it in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight. This allows it to set properly and enhances its dense, creamy consistency.
